emulator.name: PCSX2
emulator.profile: private copy of the M11 PCSX2 profile (patches, cheats and widescreen hacks disabled); save-state slot 1 SHA-256 1d8798faaeaf042caddf5f933c083dc7654f420ea26223db8bec41214926808d

operation.input: keyboard D (stick X +1) held until heading +44 reached -0.797 (running, no stop armed); then W (stick Y +1) held. After 5 completed frames D was also held (stick (0.704, 0.710)); after 8 both were released. Pad input reaches the game about two frames after a key change.
operation.feature: static +Z side wall of the starting corridor near Z 276.6; approach about 45 degrees to the wall, sliding toward -X; floor rising +X (normal about (-0.0033, 1, 0))
operation.observation_run: obs2: one continuous serialized run, 139 native stops; phases approach, contact, contact-turn, release

breakpoints: Execute breakpoints conditioned on player Z > 272.0 ([3f9308,4] > 0x43880000): stage stops 00158560, 0015ebc0, 0015fc10, 0015e420, 0015e494, 0015fca8, 00160404, 001589f0, 0012c790, 0012f8d4; push branches 0015ef80/0015f2b0/0015f654/0015fa5c; sentinels for special surfaces (0015ed3c/0015f13c/0015f4bc/0015f8c4) and every unsupported 0015e420 branch (0015e888 no floor, 0015e4ac type 7, 0015e554 type 6, 0015e594 special, 0015e6cc type 5, 0015e7c8 spawn check, 0015e858 non-0x100 hit). No sentinel fired.
native_pc_binding: Screenshot of the PCSX2 debugger at each pause; the highlighted row and both neighbours are OCR-read; a PC is accepted only when at least two of {row, previous+4, next-4} agree. Registers: tesseract majority over 15-30 preprocessing variants (ocr-vote), or read by eye when OCR was unresolved or disagreed with the calculated value (visual; f00 and f12 rows agree).
limitations: Native stops bracket stages; callee instructions are established by authenticated instructions and captured state, not per-instruction stops.
Register values are OCR or visual readings of debugger panels; RAM/scratchpad comparisons are the primary evidence.
Run obs1 (same save state, frames 1209-1219) is exploratory: its key releases were not delivered, so it has no release phase.
Discovery run disc1 (running PINE samples) is not comparison evidence.
